newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian stocks mixed, Croatia Banka dominates.
newsitem.headline: Croatian stocks mixed, Croatia Banka dominates.

text.p: Croatian stocks were mixed on Tuesday. Croatia Banka accounted for almost half the trade.
* Eight of 18 active issues rose, eight fell and two closed flat.
* Volume shrank to 12,977 from 15,804 units, turnover fell to 4.2 from 5.3 million kuna.
* Croatia Banka was most active with 5,471 shares sold. It ended at 173 kuna, up three kuna or 1.8 percent from last Wednesday.
* Top gainer Rijecka Banka rose 15 kuna or 11.1 percent to 150 kuna on volume of 100 shares.
* Shipyard Viktor Lenac, losing 18 kuna or 11.6 percent to 137 kuna, led decliners. It sold 652 shares.
Clients can view full closing results on page ZAGSTOCK.
